022        public static final float CHECK_PROB = 0.5f;
023

026                Object test = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(KEY);
027                return (PirateBaseManager) test;

066
067        protected Random random = new Random();
068        @Override
069        protected EveryFrameScript createEvent() {
070                if (numSpawnChecksToSkip > 0) {
071                        numSpawnChecksToSkip--;
072                        return null;
073                }
074                
075                if (random.nextFloat() < CHECK_PROB) return null;
076                
077                StarSystemAPI system = pickSystemForPirateBase();
078                if (system == null) return null;
079                
080                //PirateBaseIntel intel = new PirateBaseIntel(system, Factions.PIRATES, PirateBaseTier.TIER_5_3MODULE);
081                //PirateBaseIntel intel = new PirateBaseIntel(system, Factions.PIRATES, PirateBaseTier.TIER_3_2MODULE);
082                PirateBaseTier tier = pickTier();
083                
084                //tier = PirateBaseTier.TIER_5_3MODULE;
085                
086                String factionId = pickPirateFaction();
087                if (factionId == null) return null;
088                
089                PirateBaseIntel intel = new PirateBaseIntel(system, factionId, tier);
090                if (intel.isDone()) intel = null;
091
092                return intel;
093        }
094        
095        public String pickPirateFaction() {
096                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
097                for (FactionAPI faction : Global.getSector().getAllFactions()) {
098                        if (faction.getCustomBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_MAKES_PIRATE_BASES)) {
099                                picker.add(faction.getId(), 1f);
100                        }
101                }
102                return picker.pick();
103        }
104        
105        public void setUnadjustedDaysSinceStart(int days) {
106                unadjstedDaysMod = days;
107        }
108        
109        public float getUnadjustedDaysSinceStart() {
110                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().getElapsedDaysSince(start) + unadjstedDaysMod;
111                return days;
112        }
113        
114        public float getDaysSinceStart() {
115                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().getElapsedDaysSince(start) + unadjstedDaysMod + extraDays;
116                if (Misc.isFastStartExplorer()) {
117                        days += Tuning.FAST_START_EXTRA_DAYS - 30f;
118                } else if (Misc.isFastStart()) {
119                        days += Tuning.FAST_START_EXTRA_DAYS + 60f;
120                }
121                return days;
122        }
123        
124        /**
125         * 0 at six months (depending on start option chosen), goes up to 1 two years later.
126         * @return
127         */
128        public static float getStandardTimeFactor() {
129                float f = Tuning.getExtDelayFactor();
130                float timeFactor = (PirateBaseManager.getInstance().getDaysSinceStart() - 
131                                                                Tuning.FAST_START_EXTRA_DAYS * f) / (Tuning.DAYS_UNTIL_FULL_TIME_FACTOR * f);
132                if (timeFactor < 0) timeFactor = 0;
133                if (timeFactor > 1) timeFactor = 1;
134                return timeFactor;
135        }
136        
137        public static float getEarlyTimeFactor() {
138                float f = Tuning.getExtDelayFactor();
139                float earlyTimeFactor = (PirateBaseManager.getInstance().getDaysSinceStart() - 60f * f) / (120f * f);
140                if (earlyTimeFactor < 0) earlyTimeFactor = 0;
141                if (earlyTimeFactor > 1) earlyTimeFactor = 1;
142                return earlyTimeFactor;
143        }
144        
145        public float getExtraDays() {
146                return extraDays;
147        }
148
149        public void setExtraDays(float extraDays) {
150                this.extraDays = extraDays;
151        }

153        protected PirateBaseTier pickTier() {
154                float days = getDaysSinceStart();
155                
156                days += numDestroyed * 200;
157                
158                WeightedRandomPicker<PirateBaseTier> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<PirateBaseTier>();
159                
160                if (days < 360) {
161                        picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_1_1MODULE, 10f);
162                        picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_2_1MODULE, 10f);
163                } else if (days < 720f) {
164                        picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_2_1MODULE, 10f);
165                        picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_3_2MODULE, 10f);
166                } else if (days < 1080f) {
167                        picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_3_2MODULE, 10f);
168                        picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_4_3MODULE, 10f);
169                } else {
170                        picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_3_2MODULE, 10f);
171                        picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_4_3MODULE, 10f);
172                        picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_5_3MODULE, 10f);
173                }
174                
175                
176//              if (true) {
177//                      picker.clear();
178//                      picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_1_1MODULE, 10f);
179//                      picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_2_1MODULE, 10f);
180//                      picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_3_2MODULE, 10f);
181//                      picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_4_3MODULE, 10f);
182//                      picker.add(PirateBaseTier.TIER_5_3MODULE, 10f);
183//              }
184                
185                
186                return picker.pick();
187        }
188        
189        public static String RECENTLY_USED_FOR_BASE = "$core_recentlyUsedForBase";
190        public static float genBaseUseTimeout() {
191                return 120f + 60f * (float) Math.random();
192        }
193        public static void markRecentlyUsedForBase(StarSystemAPI system) {
194                if (system != null && system.getCenter() != null) {
195                        system.getCenter().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(RECENTLY_USED_FOR_BASE, true, genBaseUseTimeout());
196                }
197        }
198        
199        protected StarSystemAPI pickSystemForPirateBase() {
200                WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI> far = new WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI>(random);
201                WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI>(random);
202                
203                for (StarSystemAPI system : Global.getSector().getStarSystems()) {
204                        if (system.hasPulsar()) continue;
205                        if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL)) continue;
206                        if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_HIDDEN)) continue;
207                        
208                        float days = Global.getSector().getClock().getElapsedDaysSince(system.getLastPlayerVisitTimestamp());
209                        if (days < 45f) continue;
210                        if (system.getCenter().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(RECENTLY_USED_FOR_BASE)) continue;
211                        
212                        float weight = 0f;
213                        if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC_SKIP)) {
214                                weight = 1f;
215                        } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC)) {
216                                weight = 3f;
217                        } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_NO_FLEETS)) {
218                                weight = 3f;
219                        } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_DESTROYED)) {
220                                weight = 3f;
221                        } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_RUINS)) {
222                                weight = 5f;
223                        } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_CORE_UNPOPULATED)) {
224                                //weight = 1f;
225                                weight = 0f;
226                        }
227                        if (weight <= 0f) continue;
228                        
229                        float usefulStuff = system.getCustomEntitiesWithTag(Tags.OBJECTIVE).size() +
230                                                                system.getCustomEntitiesWithTag(Tags.STABLE_LOCATION).size();
231                        if (usefulStuff <= 0) continue;
232                        
233                        if (Misc.hasPulsar(system)) continue;
234                        if (Misc.getMarketsInLocation(system).size() > 0) continue;
235                        
236                        float dist = system.getLocation().length();
237                        
238                        
239                        
240//                      float distMult = 1f - dist / 20000f;
241//                      if (distMult > 1f) distMult = 1f;
242//                      if (distMult < 0.1f) distMult = 0.1f;
243                        
244                        float distMult = 1f;
245                        
246                        if (dist > 36000f) {
247                                far.add(system, weight * usefulStuff * distMult);
248                        } else {
249                                picker.add(system, weight * usefulStuff * distMult);
250                        }
251                }
252                
253                if (picker.isEmpty()) {
254                        picker.addAll(far);
255                }
256                
257                return picker.pick();
258        }
259
260        public int getNumDestroyed() {
261                return numDestroyed;
262        }
263
264        public void setNumDestroyed(int numDestroyed) {
265                this.numDestroyed = numDestroyed;
266        }
267        
268        public void incrDestroyed() {
269                numDestroyed++;
270                numSpawnChecksToSkip = Math.max(numSpawnChecksToSkip, (Tuning.PIRATE_BASE_MIN_TIMEOUT_MONTHS + 
271                                        Misc.random.nextInt(Tuning.PIRATE_BASE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MONTHS - Tuning.PIRATE_BASE_MIN_TIMEOUT_MONTHS + 1))
272                                * 3); // checks happen every 10 days on average, *3 to get months
273        }
274
